# <span id="aanchor140"></span> Section Editor

Sections identify parts or segments of a pipeline. Sections are populated with meters and behave much like locations. The Line Fill Service calculates the line fill on these sections.

Use the Section Editor to create, edit, and delete sections.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Section Editor:

Go to **Setup** \> **Location** \> **Section Editor**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 607;height: 427;" />

When creating a section, users must specify a section name, water capacity, water capacity units, product, and reference meter prior to saving. A section resembles a location in that it has date-effective members that are used to construct the section results.

Sections can include meters or other sections as members. They cannot have locations as members; however, sections can be members of inventories or balance locations.

The **Delete** button at the bottom of the Section Editor screen 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="vertical-align: text-bottom;width: 49;height: 16;" /> will delete the section in its entirety. The **Delete** button under the **To** date field 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="vertical-align: text-bottom;width: 49;height: 17;" /> will clear all data from the section for the selected time frame.

</div>
